result.instructions: Tools for Zammad, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show me all open tickets assigned to me, highest priority first."; "Find tickets from Acme Ltd that mention a refund."; "Summarize the conversation on the most recent ticket from Jane Smith.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Zammad data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run zammad_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run zammad_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run zammad_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. zammad_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: zammad_get_me
tools.title: Get current user
tools.description: The Zammad user this access token belongs to: id, name, e-mail, roles and groups. Use it to confirm the connection and the token's permissions. GET /api/v1/users/me.

tools.name: zammad_search_tickets
tools.title: Search tickets
tools.description: Search tickets with Zammad's query syntax. With Elasticsearch on the instance you can use fields, e.g. `state.name:open AND group.name:Sales`, `customer.email:"a@b.com"`, `title:invoice`, `number:20001`; a plain word searches ticket text. Replies carry ids plus names (group, state, priority, owner, customer). GET /api/v1/tickets/search?expand=true.

sort_by.description: Field to sort by, e.g. updated_at or created_at.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: zammad_list_tickets
tools.title: List tickets
tools.description: List the tickets the token's user can see (an agent sees the tickets of their groups; a customer only their own). For anything targeted use zammad_search_tickets. GET /api/v1/tickets?expand=true.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: zammad_get_ticket
tools.title: Get ticket
tools.description: One ticket by its numeric id (not the ticket number): title, group, state, priority, owner, customer, organization, dates, escalation and article count. GET /api/v1/tickets/{id}?expand=true.

ticket_id.description: Zammad ticket id (the number in the ticket URL, not the 5-digit ticket number).

tools.name: zammad_list_ticket_articles
tools.title: List ticket articles
tools.description: All articles (messages, internal notes, e-mails, phone notes) of one ticket in order, with sender, type, internal flag, from/to/cc, subject, body and attachment names (attachments are not downloaded). Long bodies are cut at 6000 characters; use zammad_get_ticket_article for the full text. GET /api/v1/ticket_articles/by_ticket/{ticket_id}.

tools.name: zammad_get_ticket_article
tools.title: Get ticket article
tools.description: One article by its id with its full body, headers and attachment names. GET /api/v1/ticket_articles/{id}.

tools.name: zammad_list_ticket_tags
tools.title: List ticket tags
tools.description: The tags on one ticket. GET /api/v1/tags?object=Ticket&o_id={ticket_id}. Needs an agent token.

tools.name: zammad_list_ticket_states
tools.title: List ticket states
tools.description: The ticket states of the instance (new, open, pending reminder, pending close, closed, ...) with ids and whether they are active. Use the names in zammad_update_ticket. GET /api/v1/ticket_states.

tools.name: zammad_list_ticket_priorities
tools.title: List ticket priorities
tools.description: The ticket priorities of the instance (e.g. '1 low', '2 normal', '3 high') with ids. Use the names in zammad_update_ticket. GET /api/v1/ticket_priorities.

tools.name: zammad_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: The ticket groups (queues) of the instance, with ids, names and agent ids. Zammad requires the admin.group permission for this list; with an agent-only token it returns an authorization error. GET /api/v1/groups.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: zammad_search_users
tools.title: Search users
tools.description: Search customers and agents by name, e-mail, login, phone or organization. Returns profile fields (no credentials). Needs an agent token. GET /api/v1/users/search?expand=true.

query.description: Search text, e.g. an e-mail address or a name.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: zammad_get_user
tools.title: Get user
tools.description: One user (customer or agent) by id: name, e-mail, phone, organization, roles, VIP flag and notes. No credentials. GET /api/v1/users/{id}?expand=true.

tools.name: zammad_search_organizations
tools.title: Search organizations
tools.description: Search customer organizations by name or domain. Needs an agent token. GET /api/v1/organizations/search.

query.description: Search text, e.g. an organization name.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: zammad_list_organizations
tools.title: List organizations
tools.description: List customer organizations with domain, VIP flag and member ids. Needs an agent token. GET /api/v1/organizations.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: zammad_get_organization
tools.title: Get organization
tools.description: One organization by id: name, domain, notes, VIP flag, member ids. GET /api/v1/organizations/{id}.

tools.name: zammad_add_internal_note
tools.title: Add internal note
tools.description: WRITE: add an INTERNAL note (visible to agents only, never e-mailed to the customer) to ONE ticket. Needs an agent's token (a customer's token is refused, because Zammad would make the note public). The ticket's other data is not changed. POST /api/v1/ticket_articles with type=note, internal=true.

tools.name: zammad_reply_to_ticket
tools.title: Reply to ticket (e-mails the customer)
tools.description: WRITE: send a customer-visible reply on ONE ticket. THIS E-MAILS A REAL PERSON: the reply is delivered by e-mail to exactly ONE recipient and cannot be recalled. By default the recipient is the ticket's customer (looked up from the ticket); `to` may name one other single address. No cc, no bulk, no attachments. Needs an agent's token (a customer's token is refused). For an internal remark use zammad_add_internal_note. GET /api/v1/tickets/{id}, then POST /api/v1/ticket_articles with type=email, internal=false.

to.description: Optional: ONE recipient e-mail address. Default: the ticket customer's address.

tools.name: zammad_update_ticket
tools.title: Update ticket
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of ONE ticket: state, priority, owner (agent), group and/or title. Use names from zammad_list_ticket_states / zammad_list_ticket_priorities / zammad_list_groups. Pending states need `pending_time`. Never deletes, removes or merges (those states are refused). The instance's own triggers still run, so closing or reassigning a ticket can send the customer or agent a notification e-mail. PUT /api/v1/tickets/{id}.

state.description: State name, e.g. open, closed, 'pending reminder'.

owner_id.description: User id of the agent who should own the ticket. Id 1 is Zammad's 'no owner' placeholder.

group.description: Group name, e.g. Sales (subgroups as Sales::Europe).

pending_time.description: Required for the pending states: when the ticket reminds or closes, ISO 8601 with a timezone.

tools.name: zammad_create_ticket
tools.title: Create ticket
tools.description: WRITE: create ONE new ticket for an EXISTING customer (by e-mail address or user id) in a group, with a first article recorded as written by the customer (type note or phone). It does not send an e-mail by itself, but the instance's triggers may (for example an automatic confirmation to the customer). It never creates new users. POST /api/v1/tickets.

group.description: Group name the ticket goes to, e.g. Users or Sales.

customer.description: E-mail address of an existing customer. Give this or customer_id.

customer_id.description: User id of an existing customer. Give this or customer.

body.description: First message of the ticket (plain text).

subject.description: Subject of the first article (default: the title).

article_type.description: Type of the first article: note (default) or phone.

owner_id.description: User id of the agent who should own the ticket.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Zammad
prompts.description: What you can do with Zammad here, with example requests to try.
